args.body: Count the queued CanadaBuys retrieval as the mission's single discovery attempt. Read its receipt and capture before further retrieval. Use the two remaining requests only for an original notice or official response instructions. A generic landing page or unapplied filter leaves coverage unknown. If the capture or existing records point to a qualifying original notice, tie passing and failing offline controls to its exact buyer requirement and save the actual outputs and copy-ready operator response. Otherwise record the precise source limitation and the buyer evidence that would reopen the test. Read back the result before closure with a lesson.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Use the Canadian RFQ mission’s single discovery retrieval to look for a live buyer requirement that can be demonstrated with an offline acceptance test. The catalogue rehearsal supports fulfillment for an eligible inquiry. Paid acceptance still depends on buyer confirmation and administrative action, and settlement requires separate verification.
